verdict.rationale: Porkbun explicitly documents bulk transfer submission of up to 500 domains at once, portfolio-wide auto-renewal toggling, and a full REST API for register/renew/transfer/DNS that could be scripted for bulk actions across many domains. However there's no explicit documentation of a bulk nameserver-change tool or a native 'bulk search' feature across a portfolio (only single-domain availability checks and marketplace/closeout search filters), so those parts rely on the buyer scripting the API themselves rather than a dedicated bulk UI/endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit bulk nameserver-change endpoint/UI, dedicated bulk-search-across-portfolio feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation that bulk registration/renewal at scale works smoothly.
